reason: I already have a ChatGPT project per client with the tone and rules saved, and I pay about 20 a month for it. Coast does roughly the same thing, and I would still have to copy everything into my scheduler.
objection: I already get this from ChatGPT with a saved brief per client. Coast doesn't publish, has no client approvals and has no team seats yet, so it would be one more tool and one more bill on top of what I have.
would_change_my_mind: Client approvals and publishing straight to my scheduler, so it replaces a step in my workflow instead of duplicating ChatGPT. Also a trial that lets me run a real Sunday batch for all my clients.
